scripts.dev: npm exec --workspace apps/web -- vite build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.proxy node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js dev -c apps/web/wrangler.jsonc -c apps/api/wrangler.jsonc --port 8787 --ip 127.0.0.1
scripts.dev:e2e: npm exec --workspace apps/web -- vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply ai-learning-e2e --local -c tests/e2e/workers/api.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/e2e && wrangler dev -c tests/e2e/workers/web.jsonc -c tests/e2e/workers/api.jsonc --port 8787 --persist-to .wrangler/e2e
scripts.demo: npm exec --workspace apps/web -- vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply ai-learning-e2e --local -c apps/api/wrangler.e2e.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/demo && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.proxy node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js dev -c apps/web/wrangler.e2e.jsonc -c apps/api/wrangler.e2e.jsonc --port 8787 --persist-to .wrangler/demo
scripts.migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply ai-learning --local -c apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.migrate:remote: node --env-file-if-exists=.env.proxy node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js d1 migrations apply ai-learning --remote -c apps/api/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm exec --workspace apps/web -- vite build && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.proxy node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js deploy -c apps/api/wrangler.jsonc && node --env-file-if-exists=.env.proxy node_modules/wrangler/bin/wrangler.js deploy -c apps/web/wrangler.jsonc
